candidateReports.summary: Scenario questions rewarded picking the simplest reliable design over the cleverest one.
tips: Read the last sentence of the stem first.
Eliminate options that rely on prompt instructions for hard guarantees.

mindsetPrinciples.title: Simplest thing that meets the requirement
mindsetPrinciples.body: When two answers both work, the exam prefers the one with fewer moving parts.
mindsetPrinciples.example: A fixed three-step pipeline beats an autonomous agent.

mindsetPrinciples.title: Code enforces, prompts guide
mindsetPrinciples.body: Hard limits belong in your application code.
mindsetPrinciples.example: Iteration caps live in the loop, not the system prompt.

examDayChecklist: Test your webcam and network the day before.
Flag and move on when stuck for more than two minutes.
